expected_findings.description: Hard-codes "verb": "goto" for any Goto action regardless of action.resume, making resume: edges indistinguishable from goto: edges in emitted events.
Test asserts both act.resume is True and act.feedback is False which is correct but slightly redundant with the first test given the test name emphasizes feedback_false.
Assertion assert "resume" in str(ei.value) is weak and would pass even if an unrelated error message contained the string "resume"; should check for "exactly one action verb" instead.
The resume field on Goto is parsed but not yet read anywhere in the executor path, which will make debugging harder if this field eventually influences executor behavior at runtime.
